questions.question: It took South Africa Women 23 attempts before they finally beat Australia for the first time in any format. When did that first win come?
questions.explanation: South Africa beat Australia for the first time in a T20I at Manuka Oval, Canberra, on 28 January 2024, having lost 22 of the previous 23 meetings and tied one, in 2016.
